name: [SMIOT][Ca 1] UI bao OFFLINE nhung mau van vao MongoDB (status mismatch)
message:
Ca 1 - bao offline sai. Metric smiot.telemetry.status_mismatch > 0 nghia la trang thai node hien thi/tinh trong app la OFFLINE trong khi MongoDB van nhan mau moi (mau moi hon nguong stale).

KHONG RESTART smiot.service khi mau MongoDB con moi: app dang song va dang ghi du lieu, restart se mat bang chung va co the lam mat phien. Workflow guard phai TU CHOI restart trong truong hop nay.

Dieu tra:
1. So sanh smiot.telemetry.sample_age_seconds (nguon MongoDB) voi trang thai node tren UI cung farm/node: {{farm.name}} / {{node.name}}.
2. Neu smiot.external.sample_age_seconds < nguong stale: du lieu dang vao -> loi nam o logic hien thi/cache trang thai, khong phai o luong du lieu.
3. Ghi lai: thoi diem Alert, ma ca, farm/node, khoang thoi gian lech, so mau da vao trong khoang do (Aggregation Pipeline).

Khong dung monitor nay de ket luan thiet bi vat ly hong. Du lieu la tong hop (synthetic).

{{#is_alert}}Mismatch dang xay ra. Nguoi truc: xac minh mau Mongo moi, KHONG restart.{{/is_alert}}
{{#is_recovery}}Trang thai UI da khop lai voi MongoDB. Ghi thoi diem Recovered vao ho so ca.{{/is_recovery}}
